t: You're looking at Witanhurst, a very large Georgian Revival mansion from the 1930s, standing on five acres in Highgate. It was rebuilt by the soap magnate and politician Sir Arthur Crosfield, and the architect George Hubbard designed it. It is Grade II listed. After several decades of growing dilapidation, it was sold in 2008 to an offshore company owned by the family of the Russian businessman Andrey Guryev, and it then underwent a substantial refurbishment.
